title: Sibling Implementation & Env-Var Asymmetry
summary: Detect minority omissions across sibling subclasses, adapters, env readers, or shared CLI validators, and falsify upstream compensations before reporting.

title: Parser Metadata-as-Data & Deserialization Guards
summary: Catch parsers that confuse body content with framing/metadata, drop CR-only/mixed terminators, or crash when present JSON fields are non-mappings.

title: Split-Brain Readers, Dual-Path State Leaks & Re-Registration
summary: Expose split readers reading different paths for one fact, reset/resume paths bypassing cleanup, and idempotent re-registrations wiping live state.

title: Lifecycle Snapshot Shrinking & In-Place Comparator Blind Spots
summary: Find long-lived objects indexing shrinking external snapshots with bare subscripts, plus comparators blind to mid-list in-place replacements.

title: Fake-Green Tests, Vacuous Probes & Phase-0 Repo Admission
summary: Eliminate loose caplog.text assertions, disconnected mocks, uncovered branches, and unvetted repo targets.
